answer: Operator-Linked Quota Escrow: each operator must escrow a quartz-verified deposit per active identity, tracked by a persistent operator key bound to payout addresses and device fingerprints. When a quill-signed fraud proof shows two identities share an operator, all that operator's escrows are slashed and future registrations require a plume-tier higher deposit. Cloning costs the operator its entire escrow pool per proven link, not just the flagged wallet.
